subject.title: Feature: Inter-session progress streaming for sessions_send (ACP/long-running session support)

question: Should OpenClaw expose peer run progress for `sessions_send` through a new `sessions_subscribe`/`agent.events` contract, a `sessions_send` progress option, or keep peer sends final-only for now?
rationale: The remaining work crosses session boundaries and would expose internal run events, so automation cannot safely choose the API shape, caller authorization, redaction, buffering, replay, and channel-delivery policy.

options.title: Design additive subscription API
options.body: Define an authorized `agent.events` or `sessions_subscribe` contract with bounded replay/redaction before implementation.

options.title: Keep progress scoped to owned spawn flows
options.body: Continue using existing ACP parent streaming and final A2A announcements until a broader process-event design lands.

options.title: Add `sessions_send` progress option directly
options.body: Let `sessions_send` optionally forward progress, accepting tighter coupling between send behavior and visible channel delivery.

recommendation.title: Design additive subscription API
recommendation.body: Define an authorized `agent.events` or `sessions_subscribe` contract with bounded replay/redaction before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history ties this surface to recent sessions_send, A2A, ACP, and docs work.
